subject: Sequenced commitment calendar: MSA / DPA / Order-form dependencies (Helix Therapeutics)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@helixtx.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Sequenced commitment calendar: MSA / DPA / Order-form dependencies (Helix Therapeutics)

Elaine —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together a short sequenced commitment calendar so we can align on what needs to land, and by when, to meet your target launch window (pilot start: 2027-11-01). The dependencies break down as follows:

- MSA signature (base commercial/legal terms) -> required before order form acceptance.
- DPA signature (data handling + security standard) -> must be agreed before any production data ingestion; for pilot we can provision a scoped sandbox while DPA is finalized.
- Order form (pricing, seats/capacity, billing) -> executable once MSA is signed; order form effective date can be tied to MSA signature.

I've attached a candidate mutual-action-plan (MAP) with milestone owners and suggested SLAs for review. High-level ask: can you confirm procurement's preferred review cycle (7 business days for MSA, 5 for DPA, 3 for order form) or share your required sign-off timeline?

If procurement needs a break-down by legal clause/owner, Karthik can provide a redline guide. If you'd like, we can propose a two-week rolling cadence: MSA redlines due by 2027-09-28 -> legal review complete 2027-10-12 -> signatures by 2027-10-19 -> order-form counter-signed by 2027-10-21. This keeps the 11/01 pilot target viable.

Attachments: 20270914_REDWOOD_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP w/ milestones), Helix_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW draft referenced in demo)

Quick next steps:
1) Elaine: confirm procurement review window and any internal blackout dates.
2) Laura / Karthik: prepare clause-by-clause guidance for Helix legal.
3) Jonas: coordinate DocuSign routing and fallback (standard DPA vs. custom addendum).

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: 20270914_REDWOOD_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Elaine Park <elaine@helixtx.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@helixtx.com>, Cedric Moreau <cedric@clydelegal.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sequenced commitment calendar: MSA / DPA / Order-form dependencies (Helix Therapeutics)

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear breakdown and the MAP. Procurement's expected review windows are close to what you suggested but with two caveats:

1) Our legal team requires at least 10 business days for full MSA review if there are substantive redlines (they'll triage minor edits faster).
2) Our security/compliance team requires a completed DPA with SOC2 annex before any production keys are issued; sandbox access can be granted earlier under a limited data scope.

We can aim to provide initial MSA redlines by 2027-09-30, but I need to confirm with legal whether they can commit to the 10-day SLA. Can you send the clause guide Karthik referenced and a version of the MSA with tracked changes turned on? Cedric (Clyde Legal) will coordinate our side; cc'd.

Elaine Park
Director, Platform Procurement
Helix Therapeutics
[Attachment: Helix_internal_timeline.xlsx (procurement cadence)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sequenced commitment calendar: MSA / DPA / Order-form dependencies (Helix Therapeutics)

Jonas / Laura —

I pulled the clause guide and produced a clean MSA with inline guidance for Helix legal. Key points to call out for the MAP:

- Data residency & subcontractors: propose a limited subcontractor list and a 30-day notice clause for changes.
- Liability cap: keep at 3x fees for pilot / 1MM floor; acceptability varies by customer — can be escalated.
- Termination for convenience: 30 days for pilot; auto-reversion of KV cache retention policies spelled out in the DPA.
- Audit rights: provide SOC2 report + summary; Helix can request audits with 60 days' notice (billing for third-party audit to be discussed).

I'll attach the redline and a short guide (MSA_clean_redlines.docx). If Helix needs an expedited path we can offer a limited-scope addendum that narrows accepted terms for pilot only (timeboxed). Proposed internal owner map:
- MSA negotiation: Karthik (primary) / Laura (commercial)
- DPA/security: Marissa Cole (security liaison)
- Order form & billing: Jonas / Laura

If Elaine confirms the 10-business-day MSA window, we should build a contingency: order form can be pre-filled and routed but contingent-executed (effective date = MSA signature) so procurement can pre-approve pricing. That reduces administrative latency.

Karthik
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MSA_clean_redlines.docx (docx)]

From: Cedric Moreau <cedric@clydelegal.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@helixtx.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@helixtx.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sequenced commitment calendar: MSA / DPA / Order-form dependencies (Helix Therapeutics)

Jonas / team —

Thanks for the roadmap. A couple of items from our side:

- We will review Karthik's redline and come back with consolidated comments by 2027-09-30.
- On the DPA / SOC2 annex: we need a clear statement of what telemetry/redaction Redwood will apply to Helix PII during the pilot. Please provide the SOC2 summary report and a one-page security posture note.

Good idea to pre-fill the order form and mark it contingent. That will let procurement run approvals in parallel with legal review.

Regards,
Cedric Moreau
Counsel, Clyde Legal (on behalf of Helix)
[Attachment: Helix_review_plan.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@helixtx.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@helixtx.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sequenced commitment calendar: MSA / DPA / Order-form dependencies (Helix Therapeutics)

All —

Appreciate the quick turn. Updated plan attached: I added a contingency lane and a one-page security posture summary (per Cedric's ask). If Helix can provide MSA redlines by 09/30 we'll target internal sign-off windows and aim to have executed MSA + order-form by 10/21, DPA finalized by 10/28, and pilot provisioning on 11/01.

If procurement's calendar slips (MSA redlines later than 09/30), fallback is:
- Option A: sign a timeboxed pilot addendum (covers limited production-like access) and proceed with billing hold until MSA effective date.
- Option B: delay pilot start by 2-3 weeks to ensure DPA/controls are fully in place.

Please review the attached MAP spreadsheet and the security note. Laura will open the DocuSign envelope as soon as we have Helix's internal approval; I'll coordinate routing and notify you when it's live.

Next actions (internal owners):
- Marissa: finalize SOC2 summary + one-pager (due 2027-09-17).
- Karthik: prepare a short clause digest for Helix legal (due 2027-09-17).
- Laura: pre-fill order form and mark as contingent (due 2027-09-18).

Thanks —
Jonas
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Helix_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf), MSA_clean_redlines.docx (docx), 20270914_REDWOOD_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
